stages.name: Start
stages.summary: map an unfamiliar repo; surface hidden assumptions before you build

stages.name: Plan
stages.summary: scope the work, split it if it is too big, check it survives failure before you commit

stages.name: Build
stages.summary: edit, test, debug, and reshape without changing behavior

stages.name: Review and ship
stages.summary: review, draft the PR, answer feedback, hand off

stages.name: Converge
stages.summary: drive an artifact to clean over lint, tests, review, and scrutiny rounds

stages.name: Scrutiny
stages.summary: challenge your own fresh output, a design, plan, or diff, or claims that must survive scrutiny; convene expert lenses for a wide decision

stages.name: Record
stages.summary: capture an architecture decision, or log a shortcut with its reason, cost, and revisit trigger

stages.name: Write
stages.summary: write a README, findings note, or report from a supplied template: findings first, plain words, no padding

prompts.name: orient-repo
prompts.summary: Read-only map of an unfamiliar repo before planning a change.

prompts.name: plan-change
prompts.summary: Scope a non-trivial change against the real repo before editing.

prompts.name: split-change
prompts.summary: Split an over-scoped change into focused, independently revertible units.

prompts.name: implement-change
prompts.summary: Execute the plan as small correct edits, tree runnable at each step.

prompts.name: write-tests
prompts.summary: Cover behavior and the contract, not implementation detail.

prompts.name: debug-failure
prompts.summary: Reproduce, find the root cause, fix it, pin it with a regression test.

prompts.name: refactor-safely
prompts.summary: Change shape, not behavior, proven under the same tests.

prompts.name: simplify
prompts.summary: Reuse, simplification, and efficiency cleanups on changed code, behavior preserved.

prompts.name: check-intent
prompts.summary: Reconcile the diff against the plan or the stated ask before code-review: missing, extra, or changed-approach items.

prompts.name: code-review
prompts.summary: Structured correctness-and-standards review with one honest verdict.

prompts.name: risk-review
prompts.summary: Second-gear review for a change to install/adapter write paths or anything named hard to reverse: gate the verdict on attacking the risky claims, not just reading them.

prompts.name: prepare-pr
prompts.summary: Draft the commit and PR from the diff and run the pre-merge checks.

prompts.name: respond-to-review
prompts.summary: Triage review feedback, fix or push back with a reason, reply to each.

prompts.name: triage
prompts.summary: Rank a findings list: confirm each, rate severity, route to fix, defer, or reject.

prompts.name: handoff-session
prompts.summary: Short handoff so the next session resumes with no context loss.

prompts.name: converge
prompts.summary: Fix-until-clean loop over lint, tests, review, and scrutiny, with an honest stop.

prompts.name: interrogate
prompts.summary: Harden a vague request with sharp questions before any code.

prompts.name: self-refute
prompts.summary: Red-team your own fresh output before presenting it.

prompts.name: grill
prompts.summary: Hostile stress-test of a design, plan, or diff before it is trusted.

prompts.name: premortem
prompts.summary: Assume the plan failed, work backward, and turn causes into actions.

prompts.name: prove
prompts.summary: Prove or refute many claims from the source of truth with recomputation and refutation.

prompts.name: panel
prompts.summary: Convene independent expert lenses, map their conflicts, and synthesize one recommendation.

prompts.name: repo-review
prompts.summary: Health audit of a whole repo: structure, docs truth, tests, dead code, drift.

prompts.name: cross-doc-check
prompts.summary: Compare two docs that are each supposed to state the same policy and flag a real contradiction or unexplained gap, never a wording difference.

prompts.name: repo-hygiene-sweep
prompts.summary: Orchestrate fleet topology, evidence-backed triage, and gated cleanup across repositories.

prompts.name: record-decision
prompts.summary: Capture an architecture decision as a short append-only record: context, decision, consequences.

prompts.name: debt-log
prompts.summary: Record a deliberate shortcut or limitation with its reason, cost, and revisit trigger.

prompts.name: write-doc
prompts.summary: Write a README, findings note, or report in the house voice from a supplied template.

adapters.installs: CLAUDE.md, core prompts as .claude/skills/, secret-only settings deny rules, optional terse output style.
.windsurf/rules/outpost.md always-on rule and core prompts as .windsurf/workflows/outpost-<name>.md, invoked as /outpost-<name>.
GEMINI.md and core prompts as .gemini/commands/outpost/<name>.toml, invoked as /outpost:<name>.

checks.name: structure
checks.summary: The required files and directories are present.

checks.name: catalog
checks.summary: The catalog matches what is on disk, both ways.

checks.name: prompts
checks.summary: Every prompt is well-formed and not a stub.

checks.name: templates
checks.summary: Templates exist and reference the prompt pack.

checks.name: adapters
checks.summary: Every adapter imports and exposes the plan interface.

checks.name: docs
checks.summary: The required docs exist and are not stubs.

checks.name: secrets
checks.summary: No tracked secrets and no junk.

checks.name: voice
checks.summary: Markdown is plain ASCII (em and en-dashes named) with no banned register.

checks.name: banned_sync
checks.summary: The banned register in writing-standard.md matches the words the voice check enforces.

checks.name: template_refs
checks.summary: Every prompt a template names resolves to a catalog prompt.

checks.name: templates_sync
checks.summary: The committed guide templates match the shared-core build.

checks.name: docs_sync
checks.summary: The catalog-derived spans in README.md, docs/workflow.md, and docs/plugin.md match the generator.

checks.name: doc_truth
checks.summary: The docs name the same tools and prompts the catalog ships, both ways.

checks.name: plugin_sync
checks.summary: The committed plugin tree matches the generator output and names only real catalog prompts.

checks.name: plugin_orphans
checks.summary: No stale skill ships in the plugin tree; every skill directory resolves to a catalog prompt.

checks.name: registries
checks.summary: The adapter and check registries match the code on disk.

checks.name: roadmap
checks.summary: The ROADMAP current-release line matches the kit version.

checks.name: ledgers
checks.summary: The decision index, debt entries, and roadmap sections hold their ledger contract.

checks.name: command_lists
checks.summary: Every plugin command is named in docs/workflow.md.

checks.name: commands
checks.summary: Every plugin command file has a real description and is not a stub.

checks.name: traces
checks.summary: No personal email, handle, or machine path in the tracked tree.

checks.name: label_refs
checks.summary: Issue forms and labeler config name only registered labels.

checks.name: issue_forms
checks.summary: No duplicate id in an issue form, and every dropdown or checkboxes field has options.

checks.name: prose_length
checks.summary: No markdown paragraph exceeds the concision ceiling, outside the append-only ledgers.
